tip: "Hesap lütfen" = The bill, please. Also a bank account or an online account.

examples.en: Can we have the bill?
The bill's on me.
I opened a new account at the bank.
I forgot my account password.

tip: "Kaçıncı kat?" = Which floor? "Zemin kat" = ground floor.

examples.en: Which floor do you live on?
Our office is on the fifth floor.
Take the lift up to the third floor.
The toilets are on the ground floor.

tip: Use it to change the subject or wrap something up.

examples.en: Anyway, we'll talk later.
Luckily the rain stopped.
Anyway, it doesn't matter.

examples.tr: Uçağı kaçırdık, neyse ki bir sonraki bir saat sonra.
examples.en: We missed the plane, luckily the next one is an hour later.

tip: "yürüyüş yapmak" = to go for a walk.

examples.en: I walk to work.
In the evening we walked by the seaside a bit.
How long does it take to walk there?

examples.tr: Günde on bin adım yürümeye çalışıyorum.
examples.en: I try to walk ten thousand steps a day.

tip: "Sessiz ol" = be quiet. Opposite: "gürültülü" (noisy).

examples.en: It's very quiet and peaceful here.
Be quiet, the baby is sleeping.
I put my phone on silent.
Do you know a quiet café?

tip: "Rahat ol" = relax. "Rahatına bak" = make yourself comfortable.

examples.en: These shoes are very comfortable.
Relax, make yourself at home.

examples.tr: Sınavdan sonra rahat bir nefes aldım.
examples.en: I breathed a sigh of relief after the exam.
We had a relaxing weekend.

tip: The most useful intensifier. "Çok teşekkürler" = Thanks a lot.

examples.en: Thank you very much.

examples.tr: Bu şehirde çok güzel yerler var.
examples.en: There are many beautiful places in this city.
I missed you a lot.
Don't put too much sugar in.

tip: "Tarif" alone also means directions: "Yolu tarif eder misiniz?"

examples.en: Could you give me the recipe for this dish?

examples.tr: İnternette güzel bir yemek tarifi buldum.
examples.en: I found a nice recipe online.
I cook with my mom's recipes.
Could you give me directions?

tip: "Dikkat!" = Caution! "Dikkat etmek" = to pay attention.

examples.en: Caution, there's a step!
Focus your attention in class.
Take care of your health.
Something caught my attention.

tip: Used both for sharing things and posting online.

examples.en: Shall we share the pizza?
I shared the photos in the group.
I share a room with my sibling.
Would you share your idea with us?

tip: "İletişim bilgileri" = contact details. "İletişime geçmek" = to get in touch.

examples.en: Can I get your contact details?
Communication within the team is very important.

examples.tr: Sizinle en kısa sürede iletişime geçeceğiz.
examples.en: We'll get in touch with you as soon as possible.

examples.tr: İyi bir ilişkinin temeli açık iletişimdir.
examples.en: The foundation of a good relationship is open communication.

tip: For waking someone else up use "uyandırmak".

examples.en: I woke up at six this morning.
I woke up before the alarm went off.
Could you wake me up at seven?
I like waking up late at the weekend.

tip: Used until about noon. After that switch to "iyi günler".

examples.en: Good morning! Breakfast is ready.
Good morning, how are you today?
I said good morning to my neighbour and left for work.

examples.tr: Grup sohbetine her sabah biri "günaydın" yazıyor.
examples.en: Every morning someone writes "good morning" in the group chat.

tip: "Yaklaşmak" = to approach, to get close.

examples.tr: Bu soruna farklı bir yaklaşım denemeliyiz.
examples.en: We should try a different approach to this problem.
The teacher's approach to students is very positive.
The exam is approaching, start studying.
His calm approach put everyone at ease.

meaning: to go out, to leave, to exit
tip: Takes the ablative for leaving: "evden çıkmak". "Dışarı çıkmak" = to go out.

examples.en: I left home at eight.
Shall we go out tonight?
I went up the stairs.
When is the new phone coming out?

tip: Works in any situation, formal or casual. "Selam" is the more casual version.

examples.tr: Merhaba, ben Miqdam. Tanıştığıma memnun oldum.
examples.en: Hello, I'm Miqdam. Nice to meet you.
Hi, can I get a tea?

examples.tr: Sabah ofise girince herkese merhaba dedim.
examples.en: When I walked into the office this morning, I said hello to everyone.
Say hello to your mother for me.

tip: "Seni özledim" = I missed you. Very common and warm.

examples.en: I missed you so much.
I miss my mom's cooking.
I miss the sea, let's go to the coast.
Did you miss me?

tip: "Erkenden" = early on.

examples.en: I need to get up early tomorrow.
I arrived early for the meeting.
It's still too early to decide.
Winter came early this year.

tip: "Babaanne" = paternal grandmother. "Anneanne" = maternal grandmother.

examples.en: My father is a retired teacher.
My dad and I go fishing every Sunday.

examples.tr: Babaannem bize çok güzel masallar anlatırdı.
examples.en: My grandmother used to tell us lovely stories.

examples.tr: Babası gibi o da çok çalışkan.
examples.en: Like his father, he is very hardworking.

tip: The reply is "sen de gör" - "may you see it too".

examples.en: "Achoo!" "Bless you!"
"Bless you." "You too."

examples.tr: Arka arkaya hapşırınca herkes "çok yaşa" dedi.
examples.en: When I sneezed again and again, everyone said "bless you".
Bless you, have you caught a cold?

tip: Also "cuisine": "Türk mutfağı" = Turkish cuisine.

examples.en: My mom is cooking in the kitchen.

examples.tr: Türk mutfağı dünyanın en zengin mutfaklarından biri.
examples.en: Turkish cuisine is one of the richest in the world.
Will you help me tidy the kitchen?
The new house's kitchen is very spacious.

tip: "Bana yaz" = text me / write to me.

examples.en: Please write your name here.
Text me when you're free.

examples.tr: Her gün günlüğüme bir şeyler yazıyorum.
examples.en: I write something in my diary every day.
I finished writing the report.

tip: "Mümkünse" = if possible. "Mümkün değil" = impossible.

examples.en: Could you come tomorrow if possible?

examples.tr: Bu işi bir günde bitirmek mümkün değil.
examples.en: It's not possible to finish this job in a day.

examples.tr: Mümkün olan en kısa sürede dönüş yapacağım.
examples.en: I'll get back to you as soon as possible.
Anything is possible.

tip: Also "to find out": "Sonucu yarın öğreneceğiz."

examples.en: I'm learning Turkish.
I learned to swim when I was little.
We'll find out the exam results tomorrow.

examples.tr: Her gün yeni bir kelime öğrenmek istiyorum.
examples.en: I want to learn a new word every day.

tip: Polite way to give bad news, common in shops and offices.

examples.en: Unfortunately this product is out of stock.
Unfortunately I can't come today.
Unfortunately your flight has been cancelled.
Unfortunately what you said is true.

tip: "Tam zamanında" = just in time. "Tam gün" = full-time.

examples.en: You came just in time!
Let's meet at exactly five.
What exactly do you mean?
I work full-time.

tip: The thing said takes the accusative, the listener the dative: "ona gerçeği söyledim".

examples.en: Tell me the truth.
I couldn't hear what you said.
I told him I would come tomorrow.
Let's all sing this song together.

tip: "Planın var mı?" = Do you have plans?

examples.tr: Bu akşam bir planın var mı?
examples.en: Do you have any plans tonight?
Plans have changed, we're going tomorrow.
Everything is going according to plan.

examples.tr: Hafta sonu için bir plan yapalım.
examples.en: Let's make a plan for the weekend.

tip: "İlaç almak/içmek" = to take medicine.

examples.tr: Bu ilacı günde iki kez içmelisin.
examples.en: You should take this medicine twice a day.
Can I buy medicine without a prescription?
Did you take your medicine?
Laughter is the best medicine.

tip: Also for devices and calls: "ışığı aç" (turn on the light), "telefonu aç" (answer the phone).

examples.en: Could you open the window? It's very hot.
Could you turn on the light?
I called but he didn't answer the phone.
I opened a new account at the bank.

tip: "Randevu almak" = to make an appointment.

examples.en: I need to make an appointment with the doctor.
I have an appointment at three.
I want to cancel my appointment.
I booked an appointment at the hairdresser for tomorrow.

tip: "Başvurmak" = to apply: "İşe başvurdum."

examples.en: I sent my application yesterday.

examples.tr: Başvuru için son tarih ne zaman?
examples.en: When is the deadline for applications?
I applied for jobs at three companies.
Your application is being reviewed.

tip: Also means "to reside": "Kadıköy'de oturuyorum" = I live in Kadıköy.

examples.en: Please, have a seat.
I live in Kadıköy.
I sat at the computer all day.
Let's sit down and rest a bit.

tip: Takes the dative: "gitmeye karar verdim" = I decided to go.

examples.en: I haven't decided yet.
We've decided to move.
I can't decide which one to buy.
Think carefully before you decide.

tip: "Tasarruf etmek" = to save (money, energy, time).

examples.tr: Elektrikten tasarruf etmek için ışıkları kapatıyorum.
examples.en: I turn off the lights to save electricity.
We should save a bit this month.

examples.tr: Toplu taşıma kullanarak çok tasarruf ediyorum.
examples.en: I save a lot by using public transport.

examples.tr: Zamandan tasarruf etmek için yemeği önceden hazırlıyorum.
examples.en: I prepare meals in advance to save time.

tip: Takes the dative (-e/-a): eve gitmek, okula gitmek. The t becomes d before a vowel: gidiyorum.

examples.en: I'm going to Istanbul tomorrow.
I go to work by bus every morning.
Shall we go to the cinema at the weekend?

examples.tr: Çok geç oldu, artık gitmem lazım.
examples.en: It's got very late, I need to go now.

tip: "Mesaj atmak" = to text, to send a message.

examples.en: I sent you a message, did you see it?
Text me when you're free.

examples.tr: Mesajına geç cevap verdiğim için kusura bakma.
examples.en: Sorry for replying late to your message.
I left a voice message.

tip: "Dikkat et!" = Be careful! "Dikkatli ol" = take care.

examples.en: Be careful on the road.
We need to be very careful about this.
He is a careful driver.
Watch out, the floor is slippery!

meaning: to be, to become, to happen
tip: Used for becoming and happening: "Ne oldu?" (What happened?), "doktor olmak" (to become a doctor).

examples.en: What happened? Why are you sad?
When I grow up I want to become a doctor.
I'll be at home tomorrow.

examples.tr: Bu iş olmaz, başka bir plan yapalım.
examples.en: This won't work, let's make another plan.

tip: "Yarın sabah" = tomorrow morning. "Öbür gün" = the day after tomorrow.

examples.en: See you tomorrow.
I'll leave early tomorrow morning.
Let's leave this until tomorrow.
We're going on holiday the day after tomorrow.

tip: With a negative verb: "henüz bitmedi" = not finished yet.

examples.en: I haven't decided yet.
The film hasn't started yet.
He's only twenty.
I've just arrived, let me catch my breath.

tip: Synonym: "yalnızca".

examples.en: I only want a tea.
I'm just looking, thanks.
It only takes five minutes.
I just wanted to talk to you.

tip: A warm way to end a conversation or message.

examples.en: Bye, take care of yourself.
If you're sick, rest and take care of yourself.

examples.tr: Yolun açık olsun, kendine iyi bak!
examples.en: Have a safe trip, take care!

examples.tr: Annem her telefonda "kendine iyi bak" der.
examples.en: My mom says "take care of yourself" on every call.

tip: Formal. "Müsamahakâr" = lenient. Everyday synonym: "hoşgörü".

examples.en: No leniency will be shown to those who don't follow the rules.
We should be tolerant of differences.

examples.tr: Öğretmen geç kalanlara karşı çok müsamahakâr.
examples.en: The teacher is very lenient with latecomers.

examples.tr: Bu konuda sıfır müsamaha politikası uygulanıyor.
examples.en: A zero-tolerance policy is applied on this matter.

tip: Literally "to fall from the eye".

examples.tr: O hatadan sonra patronun gözünden düştü.
examples.en: After that mistake he fell out of favour with the boss.

examples.tr: Bu dizi son sezonuyla gözden düştü.
examples.en: This series lost its appeal with its last season.

examples.tr: Bir zamanlar çok popülerdi ama artık gözden düştü.
examples.en: It was very popular once but has fallen out of favour.
When he lied, everyone lost respect for him.

tip: "Tahammül etmek" = to bear. "Tahammülüm kalmadı" = I can't take it anymore.

examples.en: I can't bear this heat.
I can't take it anymore, we need to talk.
We should learn to tolerate other people's opinions.

examples.tr: Çocuklar gürültüye bizden daha çok tahammül ediyor.
examples.en: Children put up with noise better than we do.

meaning: to make do with, to be content with
tip: Takes the instrumental: "azla yetinmek" = to be content with little.

examples.en: Let's settle for this much today.

examples.tr: Az ile yetinmeyi bilen mutlu olur.
examples.en: Those who can be content with little are happy.

examples.tr: Sadece özür dilemekle yetinmedi, zararı da karşıladı.
examples.en: He didn't just apologise, he also covered the damage.
I made do with a simit for breakfast.

tip: "Mecburum" = I have no choice. "Mecbur kalmak" = to be forced to.

examples.en: I don't want to go but I have to.

examples.tr: Otobüs gelmeyince taksiye binmek zorunda kaldık, mecburduk.
examples.en: When the bus didn't come we had to take a taxi, we had no choice.

examples.tr: Kimse sana yardım etmeye mecbur değil.
examples.en: Nobody is obliged to help you.
I don't drive unless I have to.

meaning: to reflect, to show, to pass on
tip: Also "to pass costs on": "zammı fiyatlara yansıtmak".

examples.tr: Bu fotoğraf o günün havasını çok iyi yansıtıyor.
examples.en: This photo reflects the mood of that day very well.
She never lets her feelings show on her face.
The company passed the cost increase on to prices.
This report doesn't reflect the real situation.

tip: Academic and journalistic.

examples.tr: Bu konuyu daha ayrıntılı irdelememiz lazım.
examples.en: We need to examine this issue in more detail.
The article scrutinises the causes of migration.
We examined the decision from every angle.
Let's not comment without looking closely at the incident.

tip: Used to sum up a story. Also "velhasıl kelam".

examples.en: In short, the holiday was wonderful.

examples.tr: Uçak gecikti, bavul kayboldu, velhasıl berbat bir gündü.
examples.en: The plane was late and the bag got lost: all in all, an awful day.
Long story short, we finally reached an agreement.
To sum up, everything worked out.

tip: Formal. In speech people also say "görmezden gelmek".

examples.en: We can't disregard this risk.
Don't ignore the warning signs.
Our views were completely ignored.

examples.tr: Beni görmezden geldi, selam bile vermedi.
examples.en: She ignored me, didn't even say hello.

tip: "Belirgin bir şekilde" = noticeably.

examples.tr: İlaçtan sonra belirgin bir iyileşme oldu.
examples.en: There was a noticeable improvement after the medicine.
His accent is very noticeable.

examples.tr: İki ürün arasında belirgin bir fark yok.
examples.en: There's no distinct difference between the two products.
The weather has noticeably warmed up.

tip: "Bunu vicdanıma bağdaştıramam" = I can't square this with my conscience.

examples.en: I can't square this behaviour with his character.

examples.tr: İşi ve aileyi bağdaştırmak kolay değil.
examples.en: Reconciling work and family isn't easy.
What he says doesn't match what he does.
We tried to reconcile two different views.

tip: Softer than "çok": "oldukça iyi" = quite good.

examples.en: The film was quite interesting.
I'm fairly tired, I'll go to bed early.
The prices are quite reasonable.
It was a rather long journey.

tip: Used for contrast, often with a hint of complaint: "Hâlbuki söz vermiştin!"

examples.en: He didn't come, even though he had promised.
And here I was waiting for you.
I thought it would be easy, but it turned out to be very hard.
Yet yesterday everything was fine.

tip: Literally "one's skirts ring bells". Extremely happy and excited.

examples.tr: Terfi haberini alınca etekleri zil çaldı.
examples.en: When she heard about the promotion, she was over the moon.

examples.tr: Tatile çıkacağız diye çocukların etekleri zil çalıyor.
examples.en: The kids are over the moon that we're going on holiday.

examples.tr: Maçı kazanınca hepimizin etekleri zil çaldı.
examples.en: We were all thrilled when we won the match.

examples.tr: Neden bu kadar mutlusun? Eteklerin zil çalıyor!
examples.en: Why are you so happy? You're walking on air!

tip: "Bu dönem" = this term/period. "Zor bir dönem" = a hard time.

examples.en: I'm going through a hard time.
I'm taking five courses this term.
I love Ottoman-era architecture.
Prices go up at this time of year.

tip: "Önyargılı" = prejudiced, biased.

examples.en: We should put our prejudices aside.
Don't be biased against people before you know them.
I have no prejudice on this issue.
A first impression sometimes turns into prejudice.

tip: "Kayıtsız kalmak" = to remain indifferent.

examples.en: I can't remain indifferent to this injustice.
He seemed completely indifferent to what happened.
She gave her unconditional support.

examples.tr: Çevre sorunlarına kayıtsız kalmak artık mümkün değil.
examples.en: It's no longer possible to be indifferent to environmental problems.

tip: "İtiraf etmeliyim ki..." = I must admit that...

examples.tr: İtiraf etmeliyim ki başta çok korktum.
examples.en: I must admit I was very scared at first.
He finally admitted his mistake.
I confessed my feelings to her.

examples.tr: Kurabiyeleri yiyenin kendisi olduğunu itiraf etti.
examples.en: She admitted she was the one who ate the cookies.

tip: Old-fashioned but still heard: "Münasip bir zamanda uğrarım."

examples.en: I'll drop by at a convenient time.

examples.tr: Bu kıyafet düğün için münasip değil.
examples.en: This outfit isn't appropriate for a wedding.
If you see fit, let's postpone the meeting.

examples.tr: Ona münasip bir dille durumu anlattım.
examples.en: I explained the situation to him in suitable language.

tip: Takes the instrumental: "gerçekle yüzleşmek" = to face the truth.

examples.en: You need to face your fears.
In the end he had to face the truth.
I confronted her and we talked everything through.
Coming to terms with the past isn't easy.

tip: Used to reveal what's really going on: "İşin aslı şu ki..."

examples.tr: İşin aslı, ben de pek emin değilim.
examples.en: The truth is, I'm not really sure either.
When I learned what had really happened, I was very surprised.
The fact of the matter is this: our budget isn't enough.
Let's look at the facts, not the rumours.

tip: Literally "to let escape from the eye". Perfect for small mistakes at work.

examples.en: How did I overlook this mistake?
It seems we missed an important detail.

examples.tr: Hiçbir şeyi gözden kaçırmamak için listeyi iki kez kontrol ettim.
examples.en: I checked the list twice so as not to miss anything.
Don't let this opportunity slip by.

meaning: to guess, to estimate, to predict
tip: "Tahminimce" = by my estimate. "Tahmin et!" = Guess!

examples.en: Guess who I saw today!

examples.tr: Yolculuğun üç saat süreceğini tahmin ediyorum.
examples.en: I estimate the journey will take three hours.
Nobody could have predicted the result.
My guess is it will rain tomorrow.

tip: Accepting what happens after doing your part.

examples.en: We've done what we could, the rest is up to fate.
She faced her illness with great acceptance.

examples.tr: Tevekkül tembellik değildir, önce çalışmak gerekir.
examples.en: Trusting fate isn't laziness, you have to work first.
I've always admired my grandfather's serenity.

tip: "Ayrıntılı" = detailed. "Detay" is a common synonym.

examples.en: We'll talk about the details tomorrow.

examples.tr: Bana her şeyi en ince ayrıntısına kadar anlattı.
examples.en: He told me everything down to the smallest detail.
I prepared a detailed report.
Small details make a big difference.

tip: "Nazik" = polite. "Nezaketen" = out of courtesy.

examples.en: I thanked him for his courtesy.
They only invited us out of politeness.
Courtesy is a person's finest ornament.

examples.tr: Bu kadar nezaketsiz davranmana gerek yoktu.
examples.en: There was no need for you to be so rude.

meaning: to feel reassured, to be at ease
tip: "İçim rahat" = I feel at peace about it.

examples.tr: Doktor her şeyin yolunda olduğunu söyleyince içim rahat etti.
examples.en: I felt reassured when the doctor said everything was fine.
I locked the door, so don't worry.

examples.tr: Varınca mesaj at ki içim rahat etsin.
examples.en: Text me when you arrive so I can relax.
I did my best, I'm at peace with it.

tip: Legal and formal. Takes the ablative: "haktan feragat etmek".

examples.en: He renounced his inheritance.

examples.tr: Bu haklarınızdan feragat etmek zorunda değilsiniz.
examples.en: You don't have to waive these rights.
She gave up her career for her family.

examples.tr: Tazminattan feragat ettiğine dair bir belge imzaladı.
examples.en: He signed a document stating that he waived compensation.

tip: "Karşılaştırmak" is a synonym. "Kıyasla" = in comparison.

examples.en: Don't compare yourself to others.

examples.tr: Geçen yılla kıyaslarsak fiyatlar iki katına çıktı.
examples.en: Compared to last year, prices have doubled.
We carefully compared the two offers.
This city can't even be compared to Istanbul.

tip: "Kavram" = concept.

examples.en: I finally fully grasped the topic.
He hasn't yet grasped how serious the situation is.
Could you explain this concept with an example?

examples.tr: Çocuklar yeni bilgileri çok çabuk kavrıyor.
examples.en: Children grasp new information very quickly.

tip: A very Turkish mood: "Efkârlanmak" = to feel wistful, often with music at night.

examples.en: This song always makes me wistful.
We got a bit melancholy by the sea in the evening.
He went for a walk to shake off his melancholy.
Rainy weather makes you feel wistful.

tip: "Özenli" = careful, meticulous. "Özen göstermek" = to take care.

examples.en: We paid attention to every detail.
She is a very meticulous worker.
You've prepared the food with such care.
He takes great care of his books.

tip: "Tutumlu" means thrifty, a nice extra meaning.

examples.en: His positive attitude motivated everyone.

examples.tr: Hükümetin bu konudaki tutumu net değil.
examples.en: The government's stance on this issue isn't clear.
My mother is a very thrifty woman.
If you don't change your attitude, things won't get better.

meaning: to give up (on), to change one's mind
tip: Takes the ablative: "plandan vazgeçmek". "Vazgeçme!" = Don't give up!

examples.en: Don't give up on your dreams.
At the last minute we decided not to go on holiday.
Giving up sugar was very hard.
I've changed my mind, I won't buy that jacket.

tip: "Tevazu" = modesty. Often said as a compliment: "Çok mütevazı bir insan."

examples.tr: Bu kadar başarılı olmasına rağmen çok mütevazı.
examples.en: Despite being so successful, she's very modest.
They live in a modest house.

examples.tr: Tevazu gösterme, gerçekten harika iş çıkardın.
examples.en: Don't be modest, you really did a great job.

examples.tr: Mütevazı bir bütçeyle güzel bir düğün yaptılar.
examples.en: They had a lovely wedding on a modest budget.

tip: "Yoğunum" = I'm busy. "Yoğun bakım" = intensive care.

examples.en: I'm very busy this week.
Traffic is very heavy in the mornings.

examples.tr: Yoğun bir çalışmanın ardından tatile çıktık.
examples.en: After a period of intense work we went on holiday.
Flights were delayed because of thick fog.

tip: "Sürdürülebilir" = sustainable.

examples.en: I can't keep up this pace for long.
We're keeping our relationship going long-distance.
The work will continue tomorrow as well.

examples.tr: Sürdürülebilir bir yaşam için az tüketmek gerekiyor.
examples.en: A sustainable life requires consuming less.

tip: "Etkilendim" = I was impressed / affected. "Etki" = effect.

examples.tr: Hava durumu ruh halimi çok etkiliyor.
examples.en: The weather really affects my mood.
I was very impressed by your presentation.
The strike affected all flights.
This film moved me deeply.

tip: Formal and slightly old-fashioned. Everyday: "sürekli".

examples.en: The phone was ringing incessantly.
He keeps repeating the same thing over and over.
The population is continually increasing.
Who was that knocking on the door non-stop?

tip: Literary synonym of "nafile".

examples.en: I don't want to get into a pointless argument.
Waiting is futile, the bus won't come.
Dwelling on the past is a futile effort.
It turns out I worried for nothing.

tip: "Yetkinlik" = competence. Don't confuse with "yetkili" (authorised).

examples.en: We should consult someone competent in this area.
I work with a very capable team.
I'd like to speak to someone in charge.

examples.tr: Dil yetkinliğimi geliştirmek için her gün okuyorum.
examples.en: I read every day to improve my language proficiency.

tip: Strong praise: "Muazzam bir manzara!"

examples.en: There was a tremendous view from the hill.

examples.tr: Bu proje muazzam bir emek gerektirdi.
examples.en: This project required enormous effort.
The concert was amazing, I'm still under its spell.
Technology is going through a tremendous change.

tip: "Giderek artmak" = to increase steadily.

examples.en: The weather is getting colder and colder.
My Turkish is gradually improving.
Rents are going up steadily.

examples.tr: Giderek daha çok insan evden çalışıyor.
examples.en: More and more people are working from home.

tip: Opposite: "öznel" (subjective).

examples.en: Let's try to look at the matter objectively.
This is an entirely subjective opinion.
The referee's decision wasn't objective.
The evaluation should be based on objective criteria.

tip: Literally "whether one wants or not".

examples.tr: Bu kadar çalışınca ister istemez yoruluyorsun.
examples.en: When you work this much, you inevitably get tired.

examples.tr: Yan masadaki konuşmayı ister istemez duydum.
examples.en: I couldn't help overhearing the conversation at the next table.
When you move, your habits inevitably change.

examples.tr: İster istemez ben de gülmeye başladım.
examples.en: I couldn't help laughing too.

tip: "İtibarlı" = reputable. "İtibar kaybetmek" = to lose face.

examples.en: The company's reputation was damaged by this scandal.
He worked for years to earn his reputation.
We hired a reputable lawyer.
If you don't keep your word, you lose credibility.

tip: Literally "has a mouth but no tongue". Said of someone who never complains.

examples.tr: Ağzı var dili yok bir çocuk, hiç sesi çıkmaz.
examples.en: He's such a meek child, you never hear a peep from him.

examples.tr: Ağzı var dili yok diye ona haksızlık yapmayın.
examples.en: Don't be unfair to her just because she never speaks up.

examples.tr: Yeni stajyer ağzı var dili yok ama çok çalışkan.
examples.en: The new intern is very quiet but very hardworking.

examples.tr: Ağzı var dili yok görünür ama yeri gelince konuşur.
examples.en: He looks meek, but he speaks up when it matters.

tip: "Ahenkli" = harmonious. Used for music, colours and relationships.

examples.tr: Renkler arasında güzel bir ahenk var.
examples.en: There's a beautiful harmony between the colours.
The team is working in harmony.
The rhythm of the poem really moved me.
The harmony in their marriage is an example to everyone.

tip: "Olağanüstü" = extraordinary. "Olağan dışı" = unusual.

examples.tr: Bu yoğunluk yılın bu zamanı için olağan.
examples.en: This busyness is normal for this time of year.
She gave an extraordinary performance.

examples.tr: Olağan dışı bir durum fark ederseniz bize bildirin.
examples.en: Let us know if you notice anything unusual.
Everything is running its usual course.

tip: Very common in formal and work language: "destek sağlamak", "güvenliği sağlamak".

examples.en: The hotel provides a free shuttle.
Ensuring safety is everyone's duty.
Regular sleep provides concentration.
This app saves time.

tip: "Öngörülemez" = unpredictable.

examples.en: Nobody could foresee this problem.
The regulation provides for heavy penalties.
The weather is unpredictable this season.
Risks need to be anticipated in advance.

tip: Formal "so". "Bu yüzden" is the everyday equivalent.

examples.tr: Uçuş iptal edildi, dolayısıyla toplantıya katılamadım.
examples.en: The flight was cancelled, therefore I couldn't attend the meeting.

examples.tr: Bütçe kısıtlı, dolayısıyla öncelik belirlememiz gerekiyor.
examples.en: The budget is limited, so we need to set priorities.

examples.tr: Yağmur yağdı, bu yüzden piknik iptal oldu.
examples.en: It rained, so the picnic was cancelled.

examples.tr: Talep arttı, dolayısıyla fiyatlar da yükseldi.
examples.en: Demand rose, and consequently prices went up.

tip: Formal and common in news: "riski bertaraf etmek".

examples.en: We eliminated the risk with this measure.
The danger has been removed.
Waste must be disposed of safely.
We want to eliminate the problem at its root.

tip: "Gündemde olmak" = to be in the news, to be the talk of the town.

examples.en: There are three items on the meeting agenda.
This story has been in the news for days.
I don't have time to keep up with current affairs.
I want to bring this issue up.

tip: A more expressive version of "giderek".

examples.en: I'm understanding more and more.
It got darker and darker.
The city is getting more and more crowded.
The distance between us gradually grew.

word: gözden ırak olan gönülden de ırak olur
meaning: out of sight, out of mind
tip: Literally "whoever is far from the eye is also far from the heart".

examples.tr: Taşındıktan sonra arkadaşlarla görüşmeyi bıraktık; gözden ırak olan gönülden de ırak olur.
examples.en: After moving we stopped seeing our friends; out of sight, out of mind.

examples.tr: Sık sık ara, gözden ırak olan gönülden de ırak olur derler.
examples.en: Call often; they say out of sight, out of mind.

examples.tr: Gözden ırak olan gönülden de ırak olur ama gerçek dostluk öyle değil.
examples.en: Out of sight, out of mind, they say, but true friendship isn't like that.

examples.tr: Tatile gidince işi tamamen unuttum; gözden ırak, gönülden ırak.
examples.en: When I went on holiday I forgot about work completely: out of sight, out of mind.

meaning: being away from home, living abroad
tip: A key cultural concept. "Gurbetçi" = someone living abroad (often Turks in Europe).

examples.en: Living far from home isn't easy.
He spent years away from home.
Turks living abroad return home in the summer.

examples.tr: Gurbette insan dostlarının değerini daha iyi anlıyor.
examples.en: Away from home you appreciate your friends more.

tip: "Gözlem" = observation.

examples.tr: Kuşları gözlemlemek için sabah erkenden çıktık.
examples.en: We went out early in the morning to watch birds.
I like observing people's behaviour.
We carefully observed the results of the experiment.

examples.tr: Benim gözlemime göre ekip çok yorgun.
examples.en: In my observation the team is very tired.

tip: "Geleneksel" = traditional. "Gelenek görenek" = customs and traditions.

examples.tr: Bayramda büyüklerin elini öpmek bir gelenek.
examples.en: Kissing elders' hands at bayram is a tradition.

examples.tr: Her yılbaşı ailece toplanmak bizim geleneğimiz.
examples.en: Getting together as a family every New Year is our tradition.
You should try a traditional Turkish breakfast.
Some traditions change over time.

tip: Praise for leaders: "dirayetli bir yönetici".

examples.tr: Zor durumu büyük bir dirayetle yönetti.
examples.en: She managed the difficult situation with great competence.
We need a capable leader.
The crisis tested the management's judgement.

examples.tr: Babası vefat edince aileyi dirayetle ayakta tuttu.
examples.en: When his father passed away, he kept the family going with great strength.

tip: Opposite: "olumsuz" (negative). "Olumlu düşünmek" = to think positively.

examples.en: I got a positive answer from the interview.
I try to look at everything positively.
If the weather is bad the picnic is cancelled.
The doctor's positive news relieved us all.

tip: "Ölçülü" = moderate, measured. "Ölçü almak" = to take measurements.

examples.en: The tailor took my measurements for the jacket.
Moderation matters in everything.

examples.tr: Ölçülü konuşmak her zaman işe yarar.
examples.en: Speaking with restraint always helps.
I followed the measurements in the recipe exactly.

tip: "Zarif" = elegant, graceful.

examples.en: The grace of her dance captivated everyone.
They have a very elegant home.
He even criticises with grace.
Elegance lies in simplicity.

tip: "Bilinçli tüketici" = informed consumer. "Bilinçsiz" = careless, unconscious.

examples.en: I try to be an informed consumer.
Did you do this on purpose?
Careless use of antibiotics is dangerous.
It's important to raise children thoughtfully.

tip: "Sorumluluğu üstlenmek" = to take on the responsibility.

examples.en: I took on leading the project.
Nobody wanted to take responsibility for the mistake.

examples.tr: Bu kadar işi tek başına üstlenme.
examples.en: Don't take on this much work by yourself.
The company will cover the costs.

tip: Takes the ablative: "ondan şüpheleniyorum". "Şüphe" = doubt.

examples.en: I suspected something was going wrong.
The police suspected the neighbour.

examples.tr: Bu kadar ucuz olması beni şüphelendirdi.
examples.en: It being so cheap made me suspicious.

examples.tr: Hiç şüphe yok, doğru karar verdin.
examples.en: There's no doubt, you made the right decision.

tip: "Abartma!" = Don't exaggerate! / Don't overdo it!

examples.tr: Abartma, o kadar da kötü değildi.
examples.en: Don't exaggerate, it wasn't that bad.
I seem to have overdone the salt.
He tells everything with exaggeration.

examples.tr: Sporu ilk gün abartınca her yerim ağrıdı.
examples.en: I overdid the exercise on the first day and ached everywhere.

tip: A written or formal "but". Great for essays and emails.

examples.tr: Plan güzeldi, ne var ki bütçe yetmedi.
examples.en: The plan was good, however the budget wasn't enough.

examples.tr: Çok çalıştı, ne var ki şansı yaver gitmedi.
examples.en: He worked hard, but luck wasn't on his side.

examples.tr: Teklif cazip, ne var ki zamanım yok.
examples.en: The offer is tempting, the thing is I don't have time.

examples.tr: Herkes hazırdı, ne var ki hava bozdu.
examples.en: Everyone was ready, however the weather turned bad.

meaning: to split hairs, to be meticulous
tip: Literally "to split a hair forty times". Can be praise or complaint.

examples.en: He was meticulous when preparing the report.

examples.tr: Bu kadar kılı kırk yarmaya gerek yok.
examples.en: There's no need to split hairs this much.

examples.tr: Muhasebecimiz kılı kırk yaran biri, hiç hata yapmaz.
examples.en: Our accountant is extremely meticulous and never makes mistakes.
We read the contract with a fine-tooth comb.

tip: Stronger and more literary than "hayal kırıklığı".

examples.en: The holiday ended in complete disappointment.

examples.tr: Aylarca bekledik ama sonuç hüsran oldu.
examples.en: We waited for months, but the outcome was a letdown.
It started with great hopes and ended in frustration.

examples.tr: Hayal kırıklığına uğramamak için beklentimi düşük tuttum.
examples.en: I kept my expectations low so as not to be disappointed.

meaning: save it, its time will come
tip: Literally "keep the straw, its time will come". Don't throw things away too soon.

examples.tr: Eski kabloları atma, sakla samanı gelir zamanı.
examples.en: Don't throw away the old cables, you'll need them someday.

examples.tr: Annem her poşeti saklar, "sakla samanı gelir zamanı" der.
examples.en: My mother keeps every bag and says "you never know when you'll need it".

examples.tr: Sakla samanı gelir zamanı, o kutu şimdi işimize yaradı.
examples.en: Waste not, want not: that box has come in handy now.

examples.tr: Bu notları sakla, samanı gelir zamanı.
examples.en: Keep these notes; they'll be useful one day.

tip: Literally "with unity of hands".

examples.tr: Evi el birliğiyle bir günde boyadık.
examples.en: We painted the house together in one day.
We finished this project with everyone pitching in.
The neighbours cleaned the park together.
Working together we can solve any problem.

tip: "İlk izlenim" = first impression.

examples.en: First impressions are very important.

examples.tr: Bende çok iyi bir izlenim bıraktı.
examples.en: She left a very good impression on me.
What are your impressions of the city?

examples.tr: Hiç ilgilenmiyormuş gibi bir izlenim verdi.
examples.en: He gave the impression that he wasn't interested at all.

tip: Native synonym of "kriter".

examples.en: Money isn't the only measure of success.
By which criteria is the selection made?
This product doesn't meet the quality standards.
I don't impose my own standards on others.

tip: "İhmal" = negligence. "Sağlığını ihmal etme" = don't neglect your health.

examples.tr: İş yüzünden ailemi ihmal etmek istemiyorum.
examples.en: I don't want to neglect my family because of work.
Don't neglect your health.

examples.tr: Bahçeyi biraz ihmal ettik, her yer ot oldu.
examples.en: We neglected the garden a bit and it's overgrown.
The accident happened due to negligence.

meaning: loyalty, faithfulness (to people and the past)
tip: "Vefalı" = loyal. "Vefasız" = someone who forgets old friends.

examples.en: It's hard to find a loyal friend.

examples.tr: Yıllar sonra bile bizi aradı, ne kadar vefalı.
examples.en: He called us even after years, how loyal of him.
Don't be a stranger, call once in a while.
His loyalty to his teacher moved everyone.

meaning: to count your chickens before they hatch
tip: Literally "to roll up your trousers before seeing the stream".

examples.tr: Daha iş teklifi gelmeden araba bakmaya başladı, dereyi görmeden paçaları sıvıyor.
examples.en: He started looking at cars before getting the job offer; he's counting his chickens.

examples.tr: Dereyi görmeden paçaları sıvama, önce sonucu bekle.
examples.en: Don't count your chickens, wait for the result first.

examples.tr: Kazanmadan kutlama yapmak dereyi görmeden paçaları sıvamak olur.
examples.en: Celebrating before winning is counting your chickens before they hatch.

examples.tr: Kredi onaylanmadan ev eşyası aldık, dereyi görmeden paçaları sıvamışız.
examples.en: We bought furniture before the loan was approved; we jumped the gun.

tip: "Tepki vermek" = to react. "Tepki göstermek" = to protest, to react strongly.

examples.en: What was his reaction when he heard the news?

examples.tr: Bu karara halk büyük tepki gösterdi.
examples.en: The public reacted strongly to this decision.
She reacted very calmly.
My body reacts to some medicines.

tip: Literally "to take as light". Opposite: "ciddiye almak" (to take seriously).

examples.en: Don't take this illness lightly.
We underestimated the opponent and lost.
We should have taken his warnings seriously.
Let nobody take this job lightly.

tip: For something done or allowed to happen despite being obvious.

examples.en: He lied right to our faces.
We let the opportunity slip right before our eyes.

examples.tr: Göz göre göre hata yapmak istemiyorum.
examples.en: I don't want to make a mistake knowingly.
They stole our money in broad daylight.

meaning: to carry out, to realise, to make happen
tip: Formal, common in news: "toplantı gerçekleştirildi" = the meeting took place.

examples.en: I finally made my dream come true.
The project was carried out as planned.
The operation was performed successfully.

examples.tr: Bu fikri gerçekleştirmek için ekibe ihtiyacımız var.
examples.en: We need a team to make this idea happen.

tip: "Şartıyla" / "koşuluyla" = on condition that.

examples.en: It's very hard to work in these conditions.
I read the terms of the contract carefully.
You can go on condition that you come back early.
The weather conditions affected the flights.

tip: Opposite: "tutarsız" (inconsistent).

examples.en: What he says isn't consistent at all.
Working consistently is more important than talent.
There are some inconsistencies in the data.
You need to be consistent with children.

tip: Borrowed from French. "İnce bir fark" is the native way to say it.

examples.tr: Bu iki kelime arasında küçük bir nüans var.
examples.en: There's a small nuance between these two words.
Some nuances get lost in translation.

examples.tr: Aralarındaki ince farkı anlamak zaman aldı.
examples.en: It took time to understand the subtle difference between them.

examples.tr: Nüansları yakalamak için dizileri Türkçe izliyorum.
examples.en: I watch series in Turkish to catch the nuances.

tip: Literally "to bring water from a thousand streams".

examples.tr: Ödevini yapmamak için bin dereden su getirdi.
examples.en: He made up every excuse under the sun not to do his homework.

examples.tr: Bin dereden su getirme, açıkça söyle.
examples.en: Stop beating around the bush and say it clearly.

examples.tr: Borcunu ödememek için bin dereden su getiriyor.
examples.en: He comes up with endless excuses not to pay his debt.

examples.tr: Geç kalınca bin dereden su getirmeye başladı.
examples.en: When he was late he started making all sorts of excuses.

tip: Used for the atmosphere of a place: "iş ortamı", "samimi bir ortam".

examples.en: This café has a very peaceful atmosphere.

examples.tr: İyi bir çalışma ortamı verimliliği artırır.
examples.en: A good working environment increases productivity.
I don't feel comfortable in crowded settings.

examples.tr: Ortamı biraz yumuşatmak için şaka yaptı.
examples.en: He made a joke to lighten the atmosphere.

meaning: to benefit from, to make use of
tip: Takes the ablative: "indirimden yararlanmak".

examples.en: You can take advantage of the student discount.
I benefited a lot from this book.
We made the most of the nice weather and went for a walk.
We should draw on the knowledge of experienced staff.

tip: "Hoşgörülü" = tolerant, understanding.

examples.en: Tolerance is the basis of living together.
You could be a bit more understanding.
She approaches different cultures with open-mindedness.
Mistakes should be viewed with tolerance.

tip: "Eleştirmek" = to criticise. "Yapıcı eleştiri" = constructive criticism.

examples.en: I'm always open to constructive criticism.
The film received positive reviews.
It's easy to criticise others.
Don't take the criticism personally.

tip: Very formal, often used jokingly in everyday speech.

examples.en: It's cold, therefore you should dress warmly.

examples.tr: Toplantı iptal oldu; binaenaleyh erken çıkabiliriz.
examples.en: The meeting was cancelled; consequently, we can leave early.
My grandfather used to start every sentence with "binaenaleyh".
The tea's run out; ergo, we'll be drinking coffee.

meaning: to evaluate, to make good use of
tip: Also "to make use of": "boş zamanı değerlendirmek", "fırsatı değerlendirmek".

examples.en: We'll evaluate your application and get back to you.
I use my free time reading books.
You should make good use of this opportunity.
We use up the leftovers the next day.

tip: Used before nouns: "başlıca sebepler" = the main reasons.

examples.tr: Stresin başlıca nedeni yoğun iş temposu.
examples.en: The main cause of stress is the intense pace of work.
We visited the city's main tourist spots.
I listed our main problems.
What are Turkey's main export products?

tip: "Kendini sorgulamak" = to question oneself, to reflect.

examples.tr: Her şeyi sorgulamak iyidir ama abartmamak lazım.
examples.en: Questioning everything is good, but you shouldn't overdo it.
Lately I've been questioning my career choice.
The police questioned the suspect for hours.
Don't be afraid to question your decisions.

tip: "Erteleme" = procrastination or postponement. Very common for meetings and plans.

examples.en: We postponed the meeting to next week.
I need to stop putting things off until the last minute.
The match was postponed because of rain.

examples.tr: Alarmı üç kez erteledim, yine geç kaldım.
examples.en: I snoozed the alarm three times and was late again.

tip: "Vurgu" = emphasis, stress (also word stress).

examples.tr: Öğretmen bu konunun önemini özellikle vurguladı.
examples.en: The teacher particularly stressed the importance of this topic.

examples.tr: Bir kez daha vurgulamak istiyorum: güvenlik önce gelir.
examples.en: I want to emphasise it once more: safety comes first.
In Turkish the stress is usually on the last syllable.
We highlighted the positive developments in the report.

tip: Small savings or efforts add up. A favourite for motivation.

examples.tr: Her gün beş kelime öğren, damlaya damlaya göl olur.
examples.en: Learn five words a day; little by little it adds up.

examples.tr: Az da olsa biriktir, damlaya damlaya göl olur.
examples.en: Save even a little; it all adds up.

examples.tr: Damlaya damlaya göl oldu, şimdi araba alabiliyoruz.
examples.en: Bit by bit it added up, and now we can buy a car.

examples.tr: Küçük adımları küçümseme, damlaya damlaya göl olur.
examples.en: Don't underestimate small steps; they add up.

meaning: people pick up the habits of those around them
tip: Literally "grapes darken by looking at each other". About influence, good or bad.

examples.tr: Yeni arkadaşlarıyla o da geç yatmaya başladı; üzüm üzüme baka baka kararır.
examples.en: With his new friends he started going to bed late too; people pick up each other's habits.

examples.tr: Çalışkan insanlarla takıl, üzüm üzüme baka baka kararır.
examples.en: Hang out with hardworking people; you become like the company you keep.

examples.tr: Kardeşler birbirinden etkileniyor, üzüm üzüme baka baka kararır.
examples.en: Siblings influence each other; they pick up each other's ways.

examples.tr: Üzüm üzüme baka baka kararır, ekipteki herkes artık erken geliyor.
examples.en: Good habits spread: everyone in the team comes in early now.

tip: "İmkânsız" = impossible. "İmkânım yok" = I don't have the means.

examples.en: I didn't have the opportunity to study abroad.

examples.tr: Bu şehirde spor imkânları çok fazla.
examples.en: There are lots of sports facilities in this city.
It's impossible to finish this in one day.
If you're able to, help us.

tip: "Vicdanlı" = conscientious, humane. "Vicdan azabı" = guilty conscience.

examples.en: My conscience is clear, I did my best.

examples.tr: Yalan söyledikten sonra vicdan azabı çektim.
examples.en: I felt guilty after lying.

examples.tr: Biraz vicdanlı ol, adam saatlerdir bekliyor.
examples.en: Have a heart, the man has been waiting for hours.
I can't reconcile this decision with my conscience.

tip: From "kaçınmak" (to avoid).

examples.tr: Bu kadar yağmurdan sonra sel kaçınılmazdı.
examples.en: After this much rain, flooding was inevitable.
Change is inevitable, we must adapt to it.

examples.tr: Yorgunluk yüzünden hata yapmak kaçınılmaz oluyor.
examples.en: Making mistakes becomes unavoidable when you're tired.
I tried to avoid an argument.

meaning: indeed, as a matter of fact
tip: Used to show that something confirmed what was said before.

examples.en: I said it would rain, and indeed it did.

examples.tr: İyi hazırlanmıştı, nitekim sınavı kolayca geçti.
examples.en: He had prepared well, and sure enough he passed the exam easily.
It was clear prices would rise, and indeed they did.

examples.tr: Onun haklı olduğunu biliyordum, nitekim öyle çıktı.
examples.en: I knew he was right, and as it turned out, he was.

tip: Also an adjective: "sürekli iş" = permanent job.

examples.en: My phone keeps ringing.
I keep making the same mistake.
I need a permanent job.
Constantly complaining doesn't help anyone.

tip: Literary and formal. "Sükûnetle" = calmly.

examples.en: She kept her calm during the crisis.

examples.tr: Köyün sükûneti bana çok iyi geldi.
examples.en: The tranquillity of the village did me a lot of good.
Please wait your turn calmly.
Calm returned to the sea after the storm.

tip: Formal. "İvedilikle" = urgently, promptly (common in official emails).

examples.en: We request that the matter be resolved promptly.
We need to make an urgent decision.
It's important that you send the documents promptly.
The situation requires urgent intervention.

tip: Turkish hospitality in one word. "Ağırlamak" is warmer than just "to host".

examples.tr: Bu akşam yurt dışından gelen misafirleri ağırlıyoruz.
examples.en: We're hosting guests from abroad this evening.

examples.tr: Bizi çok güzel ağırladınız, teşekkür ederiz.
examples.en: You hosted us wonderfully, thank you.

examples.tr: Şehir bu yaz büyük bir festivali ağırlayacak.
examples.en: The city will host a big festival this summer.
My mother loves having guests over.

tip: Literally "stretch your legs according to your quilt". A classic proverb about money.

examples.tr: Babam hep "ayağını yorganına göre uzat" derdi.
examples.en: My father always said "cut your coat according to your cloth".

examples.tr: Kredi kartıyla alışveriş yapmadan önce ayağını yorganına göre uzat.
examples.en: Before shopping on credit, live within your means.

examples.tr: Ayağımızı yorganımıza göre uzatıp küçük bir ev tuttuk.
examples.en: We lived within our means and rented a small house.

examples.tr: Bu ay ayağımı yorganıma göre uzatmam lazım.
examples.en: This month I need to be careful with money.

tip: "Muhakeme yeteneği" = the ability to reason.

examples.en: You should calm down first to judge soundly.

examples.tr: Muhakeme yeteneği çok güçlü bir avukat.
examples.en: She's a lawyer with very strong reasoning skills.
Our judgement weakens when we're tired.

examples.tr: Durumu iyice muhakeme ettikten sonra karar verdi.
examples.en: He decided after weighing up the situation carefully.

tip: Deeper than "özlem". "Hasret kalmak" = to long for something missing.

examples.en: He has longed for his hometown for years.
I've been yearning to see my mother.

examples.tr: Gurbette insan en çok ev yemeğine hasret kalıyor.
examples.en: Abroad, what you long for most is home cooking.
They embraced with longing.

tip: "Nafile uğraşmak" = to try in vain.

examples.en: Trying to convince him is useless.
All our efforts were in vain.
It's no use, the door won't open.
Let's not waste time for nothing.

tip: For ideas, habits and values: "yeni bir yaklaşım benimsemek".

examples.tr: Daha sade bir yaşam tarzı benimsedim.
examples.en: I've adopted a simpler lifestyle.
The team embraced the new system right away.

examples.tr: Bu fikri benimsemem biraz zaman aldı.
examples.en: It took me some time to warm to this idea.
The company adopted a flexible working model.

tip: "Büyük ihtimalle" = most likely. "İhtimali var" = there's a chance.

examples.en: Most likely I'll come tomorrow.
There's a high chance of rain.
Take an umbrella just in case.
I had never considered this possibility.

tip: "Kapsam" = scope.

examples.en: I had a comprehensive health check.

examples.tr: Konuyla ilgili kapsamlı bir araştırma yaptık.
examples.en: We did extensive research on the subject.
We need to narrow the scope of the project.

examples.tr: Bu kitap konuyu çok kapsamlı ele alıyor.
examples.en: This book covers the subject very comprehensively.

tip: Also an adverb: "aşırı sıcak" = extremely hot. Casual speech uses it a lot.

examples.en: Excessive tiredness can lead to illness.
The weather is extremely hot today.
Let's celebrate without going overboard.
Excessive consumption harms the environment.

meaning: to be interested in, to take care of
tip: Takes the instrumental: "müzikle ilgilenmek". Also "to deal with": "Bu işle ben ilgilenirim."

examples.en: I'm interested in photography.

examples.tr: Merak etme, bu işle ben ilgilenirim.
examples.en: Don't worry, I'll take care of this.
The nurse takes great care of the patients.

examples.tr: Kimse benimle ilgilenmedi, yarım saat bekledim.
examples.en: Nobody attended to me, I waited half an hour.

tip: "Tereddüt etmek" = to hesitate. "Tereddütsüz" = without hesitation.

examples.en: I accepted without any hesitation.

examples.tr: Bir an tereddüt ettim, sonra konuştum.
examples.en: I hesitated for a moment, then I spoke.
If you have questions, don't hesitate to ask.
The hesitation in his voice caught my attention.

tip: "Savunma" = defence. "Tezini savunmak" = to defend one's thesis.

examples.en: She defended her idea to the end.
I'm defending my thesis tomorrow.

examples.tr: Herkes bu kararı eleştirirken o savundu.
examples.en: While everyone criticised the decision, he defended it.

examples.tr: Kendini savunmak için hiçbir şey söylemedi.
examples.en: He said nothing to defend himself.

meaning: to tell people what they want to hear
tip: Literally "to give sherbet according to someone's pulse".

examples.tr: Politikacılar hep nabza göre şerbet veriyor.
examples.en: Politicians always tell people what they want to hear.

examples.tr: Patronun nabzına göre şerbet vermeyi iyi biliyor.
examples.en: He knows how to humour the boss.

examples.tr: Ben nabza göre şerbet vermem, doğruyu söylerim.
examples.en: I don't just tell people what they want to hear, I tell the truth.

examples.tr: Herkese nabzına göre şerbet verince kimse ona güvenmiyor.
examples.en: Since he tells everyone what they want to hear, nobody trusts him.

tip: "Kaygılı" = anxious. "Sınav kaygısı" = exam anxiety.

examples.tr: Sınav kaygısını yenmek için nefes egzersizleri yapıyorum.
examples.en: I do breathing exercises to overcome exam anxiety.
I have concerns about the future.
There's nothing to be concerned about.

examples.tr: Annemin kaygılı sesi beni de endişelendirdi.
examples.en: My mother's anxious voice worried me too.

tip: Polite reply to praise: "Teveccühünüz" = You're too kind.

examples.en: "It was a wonderful speech." "You're too kind."
He won the public's favour.
Thank you for your kind regard.
The public's affection for the artist hasn't faded for years.

meaning: to put up with, to endure / to fold
tip: Takes the dative: "gürültüye katlanmak". Also "to fold": "katlanır sandalye".

examples.en: I can't put up with this noise any longer.

examples.tr: Sevdiğin iş için bazı zorluklara katlanırsın.
examples.en: You put up with some difficulties for a job you love.
I'll bear the costs.
I bought a folding bike.

tip: Formal and old-fashioned synonym of "önem". "Ehemmiyetsiz" = unimportant.

examples.en: We attach great importance to this matter.
We need to make an important decision.

examples.tr: Dedem her zaman sağlığın ehemmiyetinden bahsederdi.
examples.en: My grandfather always spoke of the importance of health.
It's of no importance, forget it.

tip: "İstisnasız" = without exception. "İstisnai" = exceptional.

examples.tr: Kural herkes için geçerli, istisna yok.
examples.en: The rule applies to everyone, no exceptions.
Everyone without exception attended the meeting.
Let's make an exception this time.
In exceptional circumstances you may leave early.

meaning: to make a mountain out of a molehill
tip: Literally "to make a flea into a camel".

examples.tr: Pireyi deve yapma, küçük bir çizik sadece.
examples.en: Don't make a mountain out of a molehill, it's just a small scratch.

examples.tr: Her şeyi pireyi deve yaparak anlatıyor.
examples.en: She blows everything out of proportion.

examples.tr: Küçük bir yanlış anlaşılmayı pireyi deve yapıp kavgaya çevirdiler.
examples.en: They blew a small misunderstanding out of proportion and turned it into a fight.

examples.tr: Pireyi deve yapacak bir şey yok, halledilir.
examples.en: There's no need to overreact, it can be sorted out.

tip: Formal. The everyday version is "tam tersine".

examples.en: I'm not angry, on the contrary I'm very pleased.

examples.tr: Bu karar işleri kolaylaştırmadı, tam tersine zorlaştırdı.
examples.en: This decision didn't make things easier, on the contrary it made them harder.

examples.tr: Yardımın bana yük olmadı, bilakis çok işime yaradı.
examples.en: Your help wasn't a burden, on the contrary it was very useful.
I don't blame him, on the contrary I understand him.

meaning: to take care over / to aspire to, to envy
tip: Dative: "işine özenmek" (take pains with). Also "birine özenmek" (to want to be like someone).

examples.en: You clearly took great care over the presentation.
My little brother wants to be like his older brother in everything.
She set the table with great care.

examples.tr: Özensiz yapılan iş iki kez yapılır.
examples.en: Careless work gets done twice.

tip: Literally "to not hang an ear". Used for advice or warnings ignored.

examples.en: He paid no attention to my warnings.
Don't listen to gossip.

examples.tr: Doktorun tavsiyelerine kulak asmayınca hastalığı ilerledi.
examples.en: When he ignored the doctor's advice, his illness got worse.

examples.tr: Eleştirilere kulak asmadan yoluna devam etti.
examples.en: She carried on without heeding the criticism.

tip: "Vesile olmak" = to be the means of. "Bu vesileyle" = on this occasion (formal speeches).

examples.en: I'd like to take this opportunity to thank you all.
You were the reason we met.

examples.tr: Her şeyi bir tartışmaya vesile yapıyor.
examples.en: He turns everything into an occasion for an argument.

examples.tr: Bayramlar aileleri bir araya getirmeye vesile olur.
examples.en: Holidays are an occasion to bring families together.
